apps.name: Bifrost Foundation
apps.summary: The message-type kernel for Business Central: a REST API, queue, setup page and secret store that every other Bifrost app builds on.

apps.name: Bifrost Iceland
apps.summary: Icelandic message types on Bifrost Foundation: Þjóðskrá/Umsjá, Skatturinn VAT, payroll and capital tax, Seðlabanki rates, Skilagrein, island.is and SMS.
apps.summary_is: Íslensk skilaboðatög ofan á Bifröst Foundation: Þjóðskrá/Umsjá, VSK hjá Skattinum, laun og fjármagnstekjuskattur, gengi Seðlabankans, skilagrein, island.is og SMS.

apps.name: Bifrost Iceland Treasury
apps.summary: Icelandic bank connectors for Business Central: Landsbankinn claims, payments, cards, accounts and statements, plus the Draupnir IOBS/Sambankaskema signing framework.
apps.summary_is: Tengingar við íslenska banka fyrir Business Central: kröfur, greiðslur, kort, reikningar og hreyfingaryfirlit hjá Landsbankanum, auk Draupnir IOBS/Sambankaskema undirritunarrammans.

apps.name: Bifrost Iceland DocEx
apps.summary: Electronic document exchange on Bifrost Foundation: Peppol, Unimaze, InExchange and BIS 3.0 incoming and outgoing documents.
apps.summary_is: Rafræn skjalaskipti ofan á Bifröst Foundation: Peppol, Unimaze, InExchange og BIS 3.0, bæði innkomandi og útsend skjöl.

apps.name: Bifrost Attachments
apps.summary: Azure Blob, Azure File Share and SharePoint storage message types on Bifrost Foundation, with chunked uploads and attachment offloading.

apps.name: Bifrost Language Models
apps.summary: Chat and language model providers for Business Central: Copilot, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI and Gemini, plus an MCP tool server.

apps.name: Bifrost Orchestrator
apps.summary: Job queue scheduling and declarative playbooks for Bifrost message types: monitoring, restart, error handling, data flow and conditional branching.

apps.name: Bifrost Timesheets
apps.summary: Clockify time tracking as Bifrost message types, with synchronisation of time entries into Business Central Job Journals and Time Sheets.

apps.name: Bifrost Subscription Billing
apps.summary: Message types for Subscription Billing: contracts, billing pipeline, price updates, renewal, usage-based billing, deferrals and migration.
